title: TellOS PG Tenant Management — 30 s Short

cuts.dialogue: Managing 50 PG tenants and still tracking Excel?
cuts.camera_instruction: MCU (Mid Close-Up), camera slightly above eye level, fill frame with face, 9:16 portrait, natural window light
cuts.body_language_cue: Lean forward slightly, direct eye contact, pause 0.5 s before punchline — let the question land
cuts.sfx_note: Soft notification ping at 0 s to grab attention

cuts.dialogue: Every month it's the same chaos — WhatsApp UPI screenshots, missed payments, duplicate entries. You're running a business, not a spreadsheet.
cuts.camera_instruction: CU (Close-Up) face, eyes slightly narrowed, hand gesture tracing the problem in the air
cuts.body_language_cue: Right hand traces a messy horizontal zigzag as you list pain points; shake head slightly on 'chaos'
cuts.sfx_note: WhatsApp message tone at 5.5 s (subtle, once)

cuts.dialogue: TellOS gives every tenant a digital ledger — one tap and you see who paid, who didn't, and the exact UPI reference.
cuts.camera_instruction: OTS (Over-The-Shoulder) shot: phone held in left hand, screen visible in frame, app UI clearly readable; cut to phone ECU for 2 s to show tap interaction
cuts.body_language_cue: Hold phone steady at chest height, tap the screen confidently while narrating; natural, unhurried pacing
cuts.sfx_note: Subtle UI tap sound at 14 s and 18 s

cuts.dialogue: One tap. Instant ledger. Zero chasing.
cuts.camera_instruction: MCU (Mid Close-Up), confident and open posture, slight uptilt of chin, fill frame
cuts.body_language_cue: Confident smile, hold index finger up on 'one tap', then open both palms on 'zero chasing'

cuts.camera_instruction: CU (Close-Up) face, direct eye contact with lens, centred in frame, clean background
cuts.body_language_cue: Point directly at camera with index finger on 'link in bio', then hold the gesture for a full second; warm, inviting smile
